note: Curated list of well-known scholarship and sponsorship programmes for study outside Africa. Each official page was opened on the date in linkCheckedAt and named the programme (null: the site blocks automated checks). Amounts, deadlines and eligibility change every year and are deliberately not copied; the official page controls.

programs.name: Chevening Scholarships
programs.summary: One-year master's degrees at UK universities for people with leadership potential.
programs.eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries and territories with work experience, who agree to return home after the award. Check this year's countries and rules on the official page.

programs.name: Commonwealth Scholarships
programs.sponsor: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
programs.summary: Master's and PhD scholarships at UK universities, funded by the UK government.
programs.eligibility: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries; most awards are for low- and middle-income countries.

programs.name: GREAT Scholarships
programs.summary: Awards towards tuition for one-year master's courses at participating UK universities.
programs.eligibility: Citizens of the countries in that year's programme; apply through each participating university.

programs.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
programs.summary: Full-cost postgraduate scholarships at the University of Cambridge.
programs.eligibility: Applicants from any country outside the UK applying for a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge.

programs.name: Rhodes Scholarship
programs.summary: Postgraduate study at the University of Oxford.
programs.eligibility: Eligibility and deadlines are set for each country or region (constituency); check yours on the official page.

programs.name: Clarendon Scholarships
programs.summary: Graduate scholarships at Oxford awarded for academic excellence.
programs.eligibility: Applicants for most graduate courses at Oxford are considered automatically if they apply by the relevant deadline.

programs.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
programs.summary: Graduate study and research in the United States.
programs.eligibility: Applications go through the Fulbright commission or U.S. embassy in your country; rules and deadlines differ by country.

programs.name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program
programs.summary: A year of non-degree graduate study and professional development in the United States for experienced professionals.
programs.eligibility: Mid-career professionals from designated countries; apply through the U.S. embassy or Fulbright commission.

programs.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
programs.summary: Funding for a graduate degree at Stanford, with a leadership programme.
programs.eligibility: Applicants from any country who apply to a Stanford graduate programme and to Knight-Hennessy.

programs.name: DAAD scholarships
programs.summary: Germany's main funder of international study and research; its database lists scholarships by country, subject and level.
programs.eligibility: Rules differ by programme and by your country.

programs.name: Heinrich Böll Foundation scholarships
programs.summary: Scholarships for socially and politically engaged master's and doctoral students at German universities.
programs.eligibility: International students studying, or admitted to study, at a German university; check the official criteria.

programs.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master scholarships
programs.studyRegion: Europe (at least two countries per programme)
programs.summary: Joint master's programmes taught by universities in two or more European countries, with EU-funded scholarships.
programs.eligibility: Open to students worldwide; apply to each programme directly.

programs.name: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Programme
programs.sponsor: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (Campus France)
programs.summary: Allowances for international master's and PhD students nominated by French higher education institutions.
programs.eligibility: You apply through a French institution, which nominates candidates.

programs.name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
programs.sponsor: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and Dutch universities
programs.summary: A grant for the first year of a bachelor's or master's in the Netherlands.
programs.eligibility: International students from outside the European Economic Area (EEA); apply through a participating Dutch institution.

programs.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
programs.summary: Master's scholarships in Sweden for professionals from eligible countries.
programs.eligibility: Citizens of eligible countries with work and leadership experience.

programs.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
programs.sponsor: Swiss State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI)
programs.summary: Research, PhD and postdoctoral scholarships at Swiss universities.
programs.eligibility: Foreign researchers from eligible countries with a master's degree or PhD; apply through the official channel for your country.

programs.name: Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
programs.summary: Master's scholarships at ETH Zurich covering study and living costs.
programs.eligibility: Outstanding students applying to a master's programme at ETH Zurich.

programs.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
programs.summary: One-year scholarships for master's, postgraduate diploma or PhD study in Ireland.
programs.eligibility: High-calibre students from outside the EU/EEA; check this year's rules on the official page.

programs.name: Stipendium Hungaricum
programs.summary: Hungarian government scholarships at Hungarian universities.
programs.eligibility: Citizens of partner countries, nominated through their country's partner authority.

programs.name: NAWA programmes for international students
programs.sponsor: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
programs.summary: Poland's agency for academic exchange runs scholarship programmes for foreign students and researchers.
programs.eligibility: Rules differ by programme.

programs.name: Austrian scholarships and research grants (Grants.at)
programs.sponsor: OeAD, Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation
programs.summary: Austria's official database of scholarships and research grants.
programs.eligibility: Rules differ by award.

programs.name: VLIR-UOS study scholarships
programs.summary: Scholarships for master's and training programmes at universities in Flanders.
programs.eligibility: Professionals from eligible countries in Africa, Asia and Latin America.

programs.name: Türkiye Scholarships
programs.summary: Turkish government scholarships at universities in Türkiye.
programs.eligibility: International students meeting the age and grade rules for their level.

programs.name: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
programs.sponsor: Japan's Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology
programs.summary: Scholarships for undergraduate, research and other study in Japan.
programs.eligibility: Apply through a Japanese embassy or consulate, or through a Japanese university.

programs.name: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program
programs.sponsor: World Bank and the Government of Japan
programs.summary: Master's degrees in development-related fields at partner universities.
programs.eligibility: Mid-career professionals from World Bank member developing countries with relevant work experience.

programs.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
programs.summary: Korean government scholarships at Korean universities, listed on the official Study in Korea site.
programs.eligibility: Apply through a Korean embassy or a Korean university, depending on the track.

programs.name: Chinese Government Scholarship
programs.summary: Chinese government scholarships at Chinese universities.
programs.eligibility: Apply through the Chinese embassy in your country or a Chinese university, depending on the scheme.

programs.name: Schwarzman Scholars
programs.summary: A one-year master's degree at Tsinghua University in Beijing.
programs.eligibility: Applicants from any country with an undergraduate degree; check the age and other rules.

programs.name: Yenching Academy of Peking University
programs.summary: A master's in China Studies at Peking University, with fellowships for admitted students.
programs.eligibility: Applicants with a bachelor's degree; check current funding on the official page.

programs.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
programs.sponsor: Research Grants Council of Hong Kong
programs.summary: PhD fellowships at Hong Kong universities.
programs.eligibility: Outstanding students from any country applying for a PhD at a participating Hong Kong university.

programs.name: Taiwan scholarships (Study in Taiwan)
programs.sponsor: Taiwan's Ministry of Education and partners
programs.summary: The official listing of scholarships for international students in Taiwan, including the Taiwan Scholarship.
programs.eligibility: Rules differ by scholarship.

programs.name: ICCR scholarships
programs.sponsor: Indian Council for Cultural Relations (Government of India)
programs.summary: Indian government scholarships at Indian universities.
programs.eligibility: Citizens of eligible countries; apply through the official ICCR portal.

programs.name: Australia Awards Scholarships
programs.sponsor: Australian Government (Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade)
programs.summary: Development scholarships for undergraduate and postgraduate study in Australia.
programs.eligibility: Citizens of participating countries; rules and priority fields are set country by country.

programs.name: Research Training Program (RTP)
programs.summary: Tuition and stipend support for research master's and PhD students, awarded by Australian universities.
programs.eligibility: Domestic and international research students; apply through your Australian university.

programs.name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
programs.sponsor: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
programs.summary: New Zealand government scholarships at New Zealand institutions.
programs.eligibility: Citizens of eligible countries; rules differ by country.

programs.name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
programs.summary: Doctoral scholarships at Canadian universities.
programs.eligibility: Canadian and international PhD students nominated by a Canadian university.

programs.name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
programs.summary: Undergraduate scholarships at the University of Toronto for international students.
programs.eligibility: International students in their final year of secondary school, nominated by their school.

programs.name: UBC International Scholars
programs.summary: Merit and need-based awards for international undergraduate students at UBC.
programs.eligibility: International students applying for undergraduate study; check each award's rules.

programs.name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
programs.studyRegion: Partner universities, including some outside Africa
programs.summary: Scholarships at partner universities for young people from Africa.
programs.eligibility: Young Africans with financial need and leadership potential; apply through a partner university.

programs.name: IsDB Scholarship Programmes
programs.summary: Scholarships for students from IsDB member countries and Muslim communities in non-member countries.
programs.eligibility: Rules and study destinations differ by programme.
